case: Debian native project Save As and two pattern JPEGs from the offline packaged studio
platform: Debian 13.7 aarch64, kernel 6.12.117+deb13-cloud-arm64, Xvfb X11 with Mesa llvmpipe Vulkan
actions: Load the disposable revision 3 Juniper and Basin project in the packaged studio and frame the artwork.
Use File → Save as…, type current-source.weftforge in GTK and accept. The saved copy uses a different inode and matches the original project byte for byte.
Open File → Save 2D pattern JPEG…. Use the fitted 869 × 723 mm crop, 127 PPI and Grainline. Accept the GTK file dialog.
Open the JPEG dialog again. Set a 2,000 × 200 mm crop at U −1,000 and V 275 mm with Grainline and 72.4 requested PPI. Observe 72 PPI recorded.
Dismiss the GTK chooser with Escape. The backend returned code 2 with no URI. Verify retained crop, density, mark options and 5,669 × 567 dimensions, then reopen the chooser and save two-metre.jpeg.
x11_input: XTEST 2.2 input directed to the mapped app and GTK windows on a private virtual display
readback: The packaged CLI parsed the saved construction. Independent JSON and whole-file readback matched the source fixture.
The native JPEGs matched fresh current-build CLI and MCP outputs as well as the prior accepted Apple Silicon native output bytes. The independent geometry checker decoded both native JPEGs.
remaining: Wayland, a physical Linux GPU, screen-reader operation, Windows, signed distribution and unresolved third-party notices.
